on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

jobs:
  consolidate-discussions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:

        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Update audit-workflows.md
        run: |
          sed -i 's/category: "q-a"/category: "agentic-workflows"/g' .github/workflows/audit-workflows.md

      - name: Update portfolio-analyst.md
        run: |
          sed -i 's/category: Audits/category: "agentic-workflows"/g' .github/workflows/portfolio-analyst.md

      - name: Recompile lock files
        run: |
          # Recompile the lock files to reflect updated configuration
          # This would typically involve running gh aw compile on affected workflows
          echo "Recompiling lock files..."
          # Placeholder for actual recompilation command if needed
          # gh aw compile --validate --verbose

      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .github/workflows/audit-workflows.md .github/workflows/portfolio-analyst.md
          git commit -m "chore: consolidate agentic workflow discussions to single category" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:main || echo "Push failed, likely due to no changes"
